rv.q: The production succeeds in delivering a heartfelt tribute to wrestling culture while remaining accessible to audiences unfamiliar with the sport.

Ultimately, wrestling fans may enjoy elements of this production, which draws so much from that medium’s tone and style, but theatergoers in search of a compelling plot or rich character development should look elsewhere.
The stellar scenic design and strong ensemble make it a night of intrigue and fun.
This is a play that I can highly—and heartily—recommend.
This is an undeniably fun revenge story told through the art of wrestling, with slick pacing, solid performances, and an adequate amount of thematic heft baked in.

cn.t: Critics find this wrestling revenge tale enjoyable but predictable, with most praising the impressive set design and emotional performances while noting the straightforward plot offers few surprises beyond its well-executed premise.
